description.value: The Dease River First Nation Store & Fuel is a community-operated store and fuel station in the remote First Nations community near Good Hope Lake in far northern BC, serving both local members and the travelling public. Beyond diesel and gas sales, it offers Canada Post postal services and community laundry facilities. For cyclists travelling through this vast and roadless wilderness corridor, it represents one of the only service points for many kilometres in any direction.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (a March 2018 announcement on the Kaska Dena Council site) confirms the store sells diesel and gas, provides Canada Post services, and has community laundry facilities; no grocery inventory, bike parking, water refill, or other cyclist amenities are mentioned. OSM tags the location as shop=convenience, but the website does not explicitly confirm a grocery or convenience-goods selection beyond fuel and services. The phone number 250.239.3000 is for the Dease River First Nation chief's office per the contact page, not a direct store line; OSM has no phone to cross-check against.
concerns: Website content is a 2018 announcement post; current inventory and operational status have not been recently verified.
July 2023 news item mentions potential dissolution of Kaska Dena Council as a society — may affect store operations; current status uncertain.
OSM tags as shop=convenience but website only explicitly mentions fuel, Canada Post, and laundry — no grocery inventory confirmed.
Phone number (250-239-3000) is for the Dease River First Nation chief's office per the contact page, not a direct store line.
Address (Good Hope Lake, BC V0C 2Z0) is derived from First Nation's PO Box contact info, not a confirmed street address for the store.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible community store and fuel station in an extremely remote stretch of northern BC; high value to touring cyclists regardless of unconfirmed amenity details.
